params.name: page
params.description: The page number. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: The maximum number of products to return. The default is 20.

params.name: sortField
params.description: The field by which to sort results. The default is NAME. RATING: Sort by the rating in descending order. POPULARITY: Sort by product popularity, from most to least popular. Popularity is calculated from the number of purchases. NEWEST_FIRST: Sort by product creation date/time. NAME: Sort by the product name in alphabetic order.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order, either ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). The default is ASC.

params.name: searchText
params.description: Search text.

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Product category IDs. If specified, only products belonging to these categories are returned.

params.name: start
params.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Combined with count, start + count is capped at 10,000.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of add-ons to return per page. Defaults to 50; capped at 500. Clients performing bulk synchronisation should opt in to a larger page size explicitly (e.g. count=500).

params.name: parentProductId
params.description: Filter by parent product numeric ID. Mutually exclusive with parentProductUuid.

params.name: parentProductUuid
params.description: Filter by parent product UUID. Mutually exclusive with parentProductId.

params.name: country
params.description: Country code, forwarded to product display logic

params.name: currency
params.description: Currency code, forwarded to product display logic

params.name: locale
params.description: Locale (e.g. en_US). Falls back to the channel default if not specified.

items.docs: Lists add-on products visible on the current marketplace. An "add-on" is a separate catalog product linked to a parent product via an AppAssociation of type ADDON. Each entry contains the full add-on product payload (same shape as a /listing entry) plus a reference to the parent product. The `parentProductId` and `parentProductUuid` parameters are mutually exclusive — supplying both returns 400 Bad Request.
